items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: Frank Myers had it and somebody had it before him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Who had it before you?
Frank Myers had it and somebody had it before him. Well, if you could get it resonated, it'd be all right. It'd sound much better to you. Yeah. And I think it throws a tone.
It throws it out. Yeah. Morris' Modern Method. Yeah. Wiggin Morris.
